2026-11-15.verdict: All four legs survive the team-news check, so the ticket stands as built. **Croatia is the weakest leg**: a draw is enough for them and a draw loses this bet. If you want a steadier fourth leg, swap Croatia for the Houston Rockets (first reserve). Confirm Mbappé and the NBA injury reports before staking, because those were still unsettled when this was written.

France.note: At home, second in the group on 10 points and needing the result to reach the quarter-finals. Turkey have lost all five group games and are without Kenan Yildiz (injured) and Ozan Kabak (suspended). Against that, France's defence is depleted (Saliba, Koundé, Kalulu out, Upamecano left camp) and reports conflict on whether Mbappé is fit.

Croatia.note: At home against a Czech side on a run of at least five straight defeats and missing the suspended Ladislav Krejčí. But Croatia have one win and four defeats themselves, are without centre-back Josip Šutalo, and only need a draw to avoid finishing bottom, so they have no reason to chase a win late. The draw is the real risk here.

Boston Celtics.note: At home with a clean injury report. Dallas are thin in the frontcourt (Dereck Lively out, Daniel Gafford reported out by one source) and Kyrie Irving could be rested. Boston play again on Monday, so a rested starter is possible; check the line-up.

Oklahoma City Thunder.note: Sacramento are 1-11 and have lost five straight. Oklahoma City are 8-5 but on a three-game losing run, away from home, without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, with Ajay Mitchell questionable. The price already reflects a short-handed Thunder.

Houston Rockets.note: Reserve. Houston are 10-3 at a 4-9 Washington side that has Alex Sarr, Bub Carrington and Tre Johnson all questionable. Houston are without Fred VanVleet, Clint Capela and the suspended Marcus Smart; Steven Adams is probable to return.

Atlanta Hawks.note: Reserve. Atlanta are 7-6 at a 1-12 Milwaukee side, but away from home and missing several rotation players, including Kingston Flemings.

2026-11-16.verdict: A weaker day than the 15th: all four legs are Nations League soccer, because NBA prices for Monday night were not yet in the feed when this was built. Rebuild on the day to bring basketball in. **Malta is the leg to drop**: both sides are promoted whatever happens, the first meeting ended 1-1, and tipsters are split. Lithuania at home to Liechtenstein (about 89% to win, around 1.13) is a sturdier fourth leg; the page leaves it out only because the price is so short.

Iceland.note: Top of the group on 11 points having conceded once in five games, at home to bottom side Luxembourg, who have not scored in four and lost the first meeting 3-0. Reports conflict on Iceland's absences (two possible injuries and a suspension), so check the line-up.

Greece.note: At home to a Serbia side already relegated and missing two suspended players (Dragojevic, Zivkovic), with Vlahovic also reported injured. But Greece lost 7-0 to the Netherlands on Friday, and Serbia have nothing left to lose, which makes them unpredictable.

Malta.note: Top of their League D group, but both teams are set for promotion regardless, so little rides on it. Gibraltar have scored once all campaign, and that was in the 1-1 draw with Malta. Malta are away and without the suspended Alexander Satariano. Thin data and low stakes: the leg to drop.

Slovenia.note: Away to a North Macedonia side with no points, one goal scored and twelve conceded in five games, and already relegated. Slovenia won the first meeting 2-0 and still need a result to hold second place. Previews expect a low-scoring game, so a draw cannot be ruled out.
